mippify.gui.title: Mippify Settings
mippify.enableMod.tooltip:
Controls whether Mippify is enabled.
§cA game restart is required for full changes.
mippify.smoothing.tooltip: Smooths mipmaps by adjusting alpha cutout and modifying the color blending method.
mippify.fastEdge.tooltip:
Optimizes the edge filtering method for cutout textures.
Edge colors may become inaccurate.
